title: The Messenger's Cold
offer: Atchoo! I have a cold, and I must tell the smith, the horse farm and the herders about the autumn feast at Hallvik. Can you do it today? Atchoo!

steps.say: The autumn feast? I will bring my best knives to show.
We will come with all the horses! Tell Inga to drink hot honey water.
A feast! I will bring my flute. Thank you!

fact: Messengers rowed, rode and ran: news could cross a land in a few days.
